title: Vector balancing in convex order
summary: We construct Komlós signing laws with discrepancy below $6.84$, independent Gaussian reference blocks and exponentially many balanced signings. One law preserves hard constraints and exact conditional means while its reference controls every joint convex cost. We resolve both Reis--Rothvoss Schatten conjectures. For $n$ symmetric $n\times n$ matrices, one prescribed-mean signing law bounds all centered Schatten discrepancies with sharp powers of $n$ and a universal constant.
